item.title: ENJ/EFI Token Claim Processing Temporarily Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: The ENJ/EFI token claims functionality has now been re-enabled.

item.title: Enjin Platform Cloud: Intermittent Server Errors [resolved]
item.description: A distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack targeting Enjin Platform Cloud was observed earlier and appears to have caused the intermittent availability issues. Enjin Platform Cloud's behavior appears normal at this time: login and API requests are succeeding. Further investigation into the earlier DDoS-related disruptions is ongoing, and mitigations will be applied as needed.
